_doc: The nas-shapes matrix (story 59.15). tests/nas/README.md says what each field means and how to add a cell. A cell runs once its `needs` are all in `landed`; an assertion likewise.

cells.name: uid-1000
cells.about: the image's default user, every assertion of a plain install

cells.name: uid-568
cells.about: TrueNAS's apps user, its data folder owned by 568

cells.name: uid-unraid
cells.about: Unraid's nobody:users

cells.name: uid-dsm
cells.about: a Synology DSM user, its data folder owned by root and group-writable by users (100)

cells.name: uid-unnamed
cells.about: a uid no passwd file names: nss_wrapper names it, initdb and Postgres start

cells.name: data-denied
cells.about: a data folder the user cannot write: the container stops with exit 78 and says why, in both languages

cells.name: privileged
cells.about: --privileged: refused, exit 78

cells.name: media-ro
cells.about: the library mounted read-only

cells.name: media-foreign
cells.about: the library owned by another uid (2000), readable but not writable

cells.name: media-none
cells.about: a second root the user cannot list (mode 000)

cells.name: mem-4g
cells.about: a 4 GB NAS

cells.name: mem-3.7g
cells.about: a "4 GB" NAS after the kernel's share: setup goes on, on the Light tier (the 3.5 GiB floor)

cells.name: mem-6g
cells.about: a 6 GB NAS

cells.name: no-landlock-enosys
cells.about: a kernel without Landlock (landlock_* answer ENOSYS) and no user namespaces (unshare answers EPERM)

cells.name: no-landlock-eperm
cells.about: the same with EPERM for landlock_* (older Docker default profiles)

cells.name: quiet-hours-hold
cells.about: quiet hours that open later today: a new library's first scan waits for them, and Run now starts it

cells.name: vaapi-fallback
cells.about: VA-API asked for, no render device (a NAS without /dev/dri passed): libx264, the reason recorded

cells.name: vaapi-fake-device
cells.about: a render node that is no GPU (/dev/null as renderD128): its test encode fails, libx264 takes over

cells.name: vaapi-no-group
cells.about: /dev/dri passed without its group: a node the user may not open (the host's /dev/kmsg, 0644 root, read-only in the device cgroup), Settings names group_add

cells.name: restart-after-kill
cells.about: a power cut: the container killed (SIGKILL) and started again on the same volume
